web_searches.result: Exact Glasgow returned all four results: 143-1841-001, 143-1853-005, 143-1854-055, 143-1866-041. Exact Glasco returned one: 143-1838-011. All five case descriptions were read. The last two describe Glasgow (Enslaved) and Glasco (Enslaved), respectively; the other three list Glasgow as a surname without identifying a Glasgow plaintiff or defendant. No subject is identified as James Glasgow-62 or his kin.
web_searches.inspection_scope: Official index and case metadata. For 143-1841-001, visually inspected image 0001 (archive cover) and image 0002 (opening bill) only, of 89 images. The opening bill concerns James M Sutherlin and Martha his wife and her guardian Armistead G Weir; no Glasgow person was identified on these two pages. This is not a complete case reading or a negative search of all text.
web_searches.next_test: Read the remaining 1841-001 manuscript and locate its Glasgow reference; then inspect 1853-005 and 1854-055. Establish the named individual and role before comparing James’s household or drawing kinship conclusions.
